notes.title: [1.3.3] Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Note:
Steam may have trouble deleting the old files, if you launch the game and instantly get an error please completely delete the game and reinstall.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] We updated almost every system and engine in the game to make them equal to CK2 hopefully significantly improving save transfers.
[*] Saves now store a unique token that will warn you if you try to load a save not made on your computer.
[/list]

Because of the scale of this update, we are anticipating some errors to show themselves that we didn't find during testing. If you encounter any issues or errors please don't hesitate to contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/collegekings]Discord[/url]

notes.title: [1.2.7] Patch Notes + Large Game Download
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
Merged a range of CK2 fixes into ck1
Fixed the "whats_new" screen to prevent crashes

Q: Why is my download X GBs?
A: We've realised that a lot of the bugs are due to how DLCs are merged and as they haven't been updated in many months certain users are experiencing bugs that had been fixed already. Thus we have removed the builds from the DLCs to make sure the main build is available to everyone. This will require certain users to do a large download of the main files.

notes.title: College Kings 2 - Episode 1 Major Update OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=AAsp2ShwR5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

The community feedback driven Episode 1 Major Update is finally here, and it's free to all existing owners! We care deeply that you love the games you buy from us, which is why we spend the last two months improving Episode 1 based on your comments.

What you can expect:
✅ A more refined episode from start to finish
✅ More intimacy and romance, especially if you're in a relationship
✅ New scenes
✅ New choices
✅ New ending
✅ Improved save transfers

We're committed to focusing on the most important aspect of CK: your relationships. Not everything has to be all drama, gloom and doom at San Vallejo College; sometimes you just want to hang out in the park or cuddle up for a movie date with the babes. We’re also introducing growing problems for the frats that will play out over the rest of the season and culminate in the Summer Showdown. You’re in for a wild ride with the gang with lots more episodes to come in the future!

These improvements are inspired by your feedback, so please continue to share your thoughts with us as we continue to develop College Kings 2 (with Episode 2 planned for release later in 2022). 

We are really excited about the major release and recommend you replay CK2 Episode 1 from the beginning for the full experience (and transfer your saves from CK1 if you haven't yet).

Lastly, for a limited time only, College Kings 2 is [b]10% OFF[/b] on Steam as part of the Steam Summer Sale.

[b]Get the CK2 Episode 1 Major Update: [/b] [url=steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I ]steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I [/url]

- Undergrad Steve

notes.title: College Kings 2 Episode 1 Major Update Coming on June 23rd
notes.notes:
[h1][b]College Kings 2 Episode 1 Major Update Coming on June 23rd [/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=c4r_q66XDnc;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been 2 months since the initial release of College Kings 2 Episode 1. After listening to all your feedback and putting in a lot of work, we are proud to announce the upcoming launch of our major update to Episode 1 on June 23rd!

We have refined the game from start to finish, added new scenes, new choices, and even a brand-new ending. All of this content will be free to existing owners of College Kings 2 Episode 1.

We’ve packaged a ton of goodies into the new build, including more opportunities to spend one-on-one time with your favorite characters and improved save transfers from CK1! We highly recommend you replay the episode once the update is out.

The vast majority of these improvements are inspired by your feedback and discussions in the community, so please continue to share your thoughts with us. We are excited about the major upcoming update coming next week and hope you enjoy it!

The major update will come to Steam on Thursday, June 23rd!

Get College Kings 2 Episode I on Steam:
steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924480/College_Kings_2__Act_I

notes.title: College Kings v0.6 Release & Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
The 0.6 update is here! This update adds almost an hour of new story, developing character paths and giving you more pathing than ever before. 

[b]Due to significant changes in code, saves from previous versions will not work. This is a one time occurrence and your saves will be compatible with future updates. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

CHANGELOG V0.6

New content:
* 1200+ New Renders
* 20+ New Animations
* 3 Dates
* 2 Sex Scenes
* Wolves Rush Party
* Lots of main & side story progression

Gameplay:
* Even more pathing, making your choices matter more than ever before
* Added new achievements
* Added new scenes to scene selector
* New phone messages now rise to the top of contacts
* Steam Achievements support now added!

General Improvements:
* Changed a lot of the code, including revamping the entire phone code to enable a better foundation for the future

Bug Fixes:
* Fixed spelling & grammar errors from previous versions
* Fixed a lot of bugs
